heard: Some days later in Caesarea town The king and his sister arrived now To pay their respects to the new governor With great pomp they entered the hall of power Paul was brought in at the order of Festus To speak his defense before the men The king gave him permission to speak And Paul stretched out his hand in the end This man has done nothing deserving death Or imprisonment for the charges laid He spoke of the light and of the risen Lord And they agreed that no guilt was won
